name: TB-OLID: Transliterated Bangla Offensive Language Identification Dataset
description: TB-OLID consists of 5,000 manually annotated social media comments written in transliterated Bangla (Banglish) and code-mixed Latin script. The dataset addresses offensive language and abusive content identification in under-resourced code-mixed contexts across South Asian digital communities.
